title: A phone book
description:
Keep contacts in a `Dictionary` with commands.

```
> add Ada 555-0142
Added Ada
> find ada
Ada: 555-0142
> list
Ada: 555-0142
Bob: 555-0199
> remove Cy
No contact called Cy
> quit
```
hints: `book.TryAdd(name, phone)` returns false when the name exists; `book.Remove(name)` returns whether it removed anything.
`foreach (var (name, phone) in book.OrderBy(p => p.Key))` lists them in order.
requirements: `add` refuses a name that is already there; `list` prints in alphabetical order.
Unknown commands print `Commands: add, find, remove, list, quit`.
stretch: Store the name with its original capitals in a record `Contact(string Name, string Phone)` as the value.
